acceptedAnswer.text: An accurate penthouse valuation in areas like Miami, Aventura, or Brickell requires specialized expertise in high-end real estate and local market nuances. Valuers need a deep understanding of luxury finishes, smart home technology, and the value placed on exclusive amenities and services within top-tier buildings. Our team at Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution possesses this specific market knowledge, which is critical for correctly assessing properties where standard comparables are scarce and unique features drive value.
